title: Nagada Sang Dhol (From Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela)
artist: Sanjay Leela Bhansali, Shreya Ghoshal, Osman Mir
label: Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd. / Eros Now Music
description: A 2013 film track from Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela by Sanjay Leela Bhansali, Shreya Ghoshal and Osman Mir; current providers differ between October 2 and October 15 release dates while the 4:33 recording remains consistent.
notes: Some sources expose October 2, 2013 while the current Spotify soundtrack page exposes October 15, 2013. The version and 4:33 duration are consistent; the provider date difference is retained as provenance rather than silently merged.

title: Shubhaarambh (From Kai Po Che)
artist: Amit Trivedi, Shruti Pathak, Divya Kumar
label: UTV under exclusive license to Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
description: A 2013 Kai Po Che soundtrack track by Amit Trivedi, Shruti Pathak and Divya Kumar; this canonical record is the 3:54 original soundtrack version, distinct from the later 3:08 single edit.
notes: The original soundtrack version is 3:54. A later November 2013 one-song single exposes a shorter 3:08 edit and is not collapsed into this canonical soundtrack version.

title: Dholi Taro Dhol Baaje (From Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam)
artist: Kavita Krishnamurthy, Vinod Rathod, Karsan Sagathiya
label: Super Cassettes Industries Private Limited / T-Series
description: A 1999 Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam film track by Kavita Krishnamurthy, Vinod Rathod and Karsan Sagathiya; the cited T-Series 8K YouTube upload is retained as a 2025 reissue of the original recording.
notes: The cited T-Series 8K YouTube upload is a 2025 reissue of the original 1999 film song; original release year remains 1999.
